name: chess-app
comment:overrides: drizzle-kit still pulls the deprecated @esbuild-kit/esm-loader, which pins an esbuild below 0.24.3 and trips GHSA-67mh-4wv8-2f99 on every npm audit. The advisory is about esbuild's dev server, which nothing here runs, but a permanently failing audit is a broken gate. Forcing a current esbuild clears it. Drop this once drizzle-kit stops depending on the loader. js-yaml: @redocly/openapi-core (via openapi-typescript) pins 4.3.1 exactly, which trips GHSA-2883-xcg3-v3hh; 4.3.2 is the patched release; pinned exactly because a caret spec was ignored on re-resolution.
comment:prepare: Wires the pre-commit hook by pointing git at .githooks/ instead of .git/hooks/, which keeps the hooks in the repository where they are reviewed and versioned. Runs on npm install, so a fresh clone gets the gates without a separate setup step and without a hook-runner dependency.

scripts.typecheck: npm run generate && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run generate && vitest run --project unit --project web
scripts.test:coverage: npm run generate && vitest run --coverage --project unit --project web
